title: What is car leasing?
text: Car leasing is a way to drive a new or used vehicle for a fixed period (usually 2–5 years) without owning it. You pay a monthly fee and return the vehicle at the end of the lease term, or you may have the option to buy it.

title: Who is eligible to lease a car?
text: You must be at least 18 years old, have a valid driver’s license, and show proof of income. A credit check is usually required

title: Can I lease a car with bad credit?
text: Yes, but your options may be limited. A co-signer or a larger down payment might be required.

title: What is included in the lease price?
text: The monthly lease payment typically includes the vehicle’s depreciation, interest, and sometimes maintenance or service packages.

title: Can I end my lease early?
text: Yes, but early termination fees may apply. Contact us for more details on your specific lease agreement

title: What types of cars can I lease?
text: We offer a wide range of new and used vehicles, including sedans, SUVs, electric cars, and commercial vehicles.
